scope: Two serial profiled arms. The joint observer gate requires both arms to pass.

observer_gate.scope: Two bracketing clean individual requests and one traced request per arm. TTFT p50/p95 are the same single observation. This is a serial observer check.

arms.scope: Clock-aligned union of concurrent-kernel intervals. This window has one test request, with per-process kernel activity rather than per-kernel request attribution. Kernel intersections do not include DMA, imply a deadline-safe budget, or qualify online benefit.
